current_milestone: The continual runtime no longer limits randomized CEGIS to three fixed numeric targets. A seed now generates a combinatorial family of hundreds of exact bounded pure typed threshold programs from existing arithmetic and conditional kernels. The evaluator commits to the generated target, diagnostics, and sealed final holdout before learning; the learner receives only one-sided demonstrations and first-failure counterexamples. Promotion requires a deliberately failing protected regression followed by intact exact-scope deterministic regression, fresh-engine execution, and retention of a prior verified acquired capability. The preceding shifted-threshold experiment also retains three successive specification failures, including a fractional counterexample that distinguishes a continuous target from an integer-only overfit.

claim_boundary: No architecture, hourly model choice, CI/reference result, bounded learning campaign, trial-ledger result, internal regression decision, self-produced artifact, or unsigned/unverified independence assertion counts as verified AGI. A verified claim requires the conservative external production evidence gate to pass on genuinely independent auditable evidence with no unresolved failures or contamination.
